name: rust-discover-all-manifests
body: The Rust frontend must discover all Cargo manifests under the scan root (not just one), load each project/workspace, emit facts for all of them, and merge the streams into one graph. Discovery is frontend-side — the frontend decides what a project is — consistent with the existing multi-module Go handling and the module-directory forwarding in src/main.rs (cmd_scan). AC: scanning a repo root that contains a nested standalone crate produces that crate's module node and its symbols, in addition to the root package's.
